# Outfit Zone

> Outfit Zone is an Egyptian men's streetwear storefront offering men's streetwear and cash on delivery.

## Public pages

- [Homepage](https://outfitzone-eg.vercel.app/)
- [Product collection](https://outfitzone-eg.vercel.app/products)
- [About the brand](https://outfitzone-eg.vercel.app/about)
- [Contact](https://outfitzone-eg.vercel.app/contact)

## Store information

The storefront presents men's streetwear styles including Box Fit and Oversized clothing. The site supports cash on delivery. Product availability, prices, sizing, delivery terms, and current policies should be checked on the live storefront.
